Hello!
I just released a small, hellish update to the game with 1 new weapon. I'll let you discover the new weapon for yourself. :)

notes.title: Bacon Rebellion - Update v1.1.1
notes.notes:
Hey!

Thanks to everyone who bought the game so far, it's much appreciated!
I have released a small update to the game, which fixes some small things and adds a little bit of content and QoL changes. 
Hope you enjoy it!
Thanks!

[b]v1.1.1 Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Smaller HP and Stamina bars now show up above the character when HP and Stamina is not at maximum. 
[*] Exploding Barrels - Several exploding barrels are now placed around the level.
[*] Parachuting Barrels - Every now and then a parachute with a barrel drops from the sky, allowing you to explode more.
[*] A Perk that makes barrels fall from the sky more often.
[*] Fixed a small bug with leaderboard entries not displaying correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Bacon Rebellion releasing 8th January!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Bacon Rebellion is finally coming out - 8th January 2021! Yes, tomorrow! 
I know the game has been in development for so long, there have been several reasons for that - lack of motivation to work on games, health problems, having to work other jobs, as well as feature creep and other developmental issues. But over the last months I decided to scale the game back down a little, and release it as a small arcade shooter, mainly focused on highscores and lots of shooting, or else the game might linger in this in-development state for way too long. 
The game is going to cost 3.99$ with a 30% launch discount. Hopefully you enjoy it!
For those who got this several years ago in Groupees, the keys should be in your Groupees account now.

Thanks for all the patience!
Nauris

notes.title: The Inner Darkness - released!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

If you enjoyed any of my other games, you should know that I just released my newest game The Inner Darkness.
It is a mysterious puzzle platformer with a dimension switching mechanic.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/562160/

It's right now on a 20% launch discount too. Anyway, check it out!

Also this means that work on Bacon Rebellion is resuming! Stay tuned! :)

Thanks a lot!

Nauris
